fieldData.full-article-text:
Upgrading to Tier 2 AML should only take a few minutes, you can check the status of your AML upgrade in your Account Summary. 

Upgrading to Tier 3 or 4 can take between 2-4 weeks. This is because the documentation must be manually reviewed by a member of our compliance team and will sometimes require follow-on questions or additional documentation. You will receive an email to let you know if your application has been successful or not or if more information is required.
fieldData.name: How Long Do AML Tier Upgrades Take?
